name: ChordRes with terminal lookahead
tagline: Read the final spherical state through its learned velocity lookahead.
description: The Chord sublayers start from rest and retain BF16 forces. A separate zero-initialized scalar multiplies the terminal tangent velocity before the native final RMSNorm and LM head.
mechanism: Unit-RMS hidden state and a per-token tangent velocity
Independent scalar controls for each attention and FFN site
BF16 force tensors retained on the GPU for the fused Chord backward
A scalar terminal velocity read before the shared final norm and LM head
limitations: The matched-normal high-control-LR comparison uses a research initialization and optimizer-group override.

nodes: Final h + rho*v, RMSNorm and LM head
